definitions.explanation: A student in the same grade or class.

examples.japanese: {同級生|どうきゅうせい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{同級生|どうきゅうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I ran into a high school classmate.

notes:
{同級生|どうきゅうせい} combines {同|どう} (same) + {級|きゅう} (grade) + {生|せい} (student).

DISTINCTIONS:
- {同級生|どうきゅうせい}: classmate (same grade level)
- クラスメート: classmate (same class)
- ⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧: colleague who joined at the same time
- ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧: upperclassman
- ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧: underclassman
